key_insight: A spray distance of 190 mm produced the most compact Cr3C2–NiCr coating on DSS 2205 and the best corrosion resistance in 1 M H2SO4.
engineering_relevance: Optimizing detonation-gun spray distance can significantly improve coating integrity and extend the life of stainless-steel components in acidic industrial service.
method: D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr onto DSS 2205 at 170, 180, and 190 mm.
Characterized coating structure with SEM and porosity measurements.
Evaluated corrosion behavior in 1 M H2SO4 using OCP, EIS, and potentiodynamic polarization.
evidence_signal: The 190 mm coating had the lowest reported corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), while porosity decreased from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm.
watch_item: The optimum distance is specific to the tested powder, substrate, and acid environment, so it should be revalidated before scaling to other systems or service conditions.
paper_title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
